name: Simulated 100-floor tower flattened to a row of floors, daily PM2.5 per floor

spatialCoverage.name: Synthetic (open ocean at longitude 0, latitude 0; no real place)

description: SIMULATED data for a 100-floor tower flattened to a row of adjacent floor geometries (100 floor polygons; floor k is the 30 m by 30 m rectangle starting at x = 30(k-1) m, so height is the x axis). Daily mean PM2.5 of the four sensors on the floor, one value per day of 2019. Particle levels rise with height by design and are illustrative, not physical. It is not a measurement of any real exposure.

about.name: ETL process for the simulated tower floors
about.description: The CSV (WKT geometry plus a daily jsonb series) is published by the tower generator and loaded into a raw table with ogr2ogr; the postgis step builds the typed table, converts the series to jsonb, adds geom_local and the spatial index.

variableMeasured.name: pm25_floor_mean
variableMeasured.description: Daily mean PM2.5 of the four sensors on the floor, stored as a jsonb object with date ranges as keys (startDate/endDate formatted as YYYY-MM-DD/YYYY-MM-DD) and PM2.5 values for each date key.
